name: trommi
description: Chat and decision cards between a person and their Claude Code sessions, end-to-end encrypted
//: test: everything that needs no browser and no hub binary: types, the app's layout, the model, the hub client and the account against a fake hub, the client against a stand-in for what the core's binding lacks. Needs the Rust core built once: npm run build:core.
test:browser: the same layers in headless Chromium (the store and tabs, the build with the core, the MLS proof screen).
With TROMMI_HUB_BIN set to a hub binary, the hub and account tests also run against the real hub.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:app && npm run test:web
scripts.test:browser: node tests/web/store/run.mjs && node --test tests/web/build/build.test.mjs && node tests/web/build/wasm-load.mjs && node tests/web/proof/proof.mjs
